systems.country_label: Centre national de recueil et d'enregistrement des données criminelles (CNREDC), relevant du système d'information policière d'Afrique de l'ouest (SIPAO)
systems.owner: Direction générale de la Sûreté nationale; financed under cooperation between Mauritania, the European Union and INTERPOL
systems.tiers: one national centre at DGSN headquarters in Nouakchott, inaugurated 1 October 2021; no count of connected units

note: No fact: the document describes the centre by the exchange of data between the police and other law-enforcement bodies and with other countries, and does not say that stations enter reports or cases in it. Its name says it collects and records criminal data, at headquarters only; the parent may read that as a record system running in the capital, in which case the document gives owner (DGSN) and finance (EU and INTERPOL cooperation), as of 2021-10-01.
